theme_central: Oath by the panting warhorses to denounce man's ingratitude and his passionate attachment to wealth — while everything will be overturned and made known.
sources_note: Universally known content, no possible divergence.

branches.title: Oath by the warhorses
branches.resume: Panting warhorses, striking sparks, charging at dawn in a cloud of dust.

children.t: Oath by the panting warhorses charging at dawn

branches.title: Ingratitude, attachment to wealth
branches.resume: Man is ungrateful toward his Lord, passionately attached to riches.

children.t: Man's ingratitude, passionate attachment to riches

branches.title: Resurrection, closing
branches.resume: Contents of the graves overturned, secrets of hearts brought to light, Allah perfectly informed.

children.t: Resurrection, secrets brought to light, Allah's omniscience
